value.rationale: The quaternary partial-permutation setting is natural for nucleotide ranking codes. A maximum-size theorem cannot quantify optimal design flexibility or the minimum number of rank positions across all codewords. The complete length enumerator distinguishes 8,503,056 maxima, identifies 4,096 minimal-length designs with cost 88, and improves the length sum by 16 over a known 24-length-four plus four-length-two construction, without claiming experimental cost savings.
